title: What if the Atlantic's warm current stopped? 🌊
subject: ocean
description:
Could your city handle minus 20? 👇

What happens if the AMOC, the Atlantic current system that warms Europe, collapses? A 2025 Utrecht University simulation found Arctic sea ice reaching Britain and record-breaking winter cold, even in a warming world. It's one model, and scientists still debate if and when a collapse could happen.

Sources: van Westen et al., "European temperature extremes under different AMOC scenarios in the Community Earth System Model", Geophysical Research Letters (2025); Carbon Brief ("Ocean current 'collapse' could trigger 'profound cooling' in northern Europe", June 2025); CNN/AccuWeather (June 2025)
tags: what if the gulf stream stopped

scenes.text: If one Atlantic current stopped, London could hit minus 20.
It's called the AMOC. It carries warm tropical water north toward Europe.
In 2025, René van Westen at Utrecht University simulated it collapsing in a world 2 degrees warmer.
Every February, Arctic sea ice would reach Scandinavia and much of Britain.
Edinburgh's coldest winters would near minus 30 Celsius. Oslo's, minus 48.
It's one model, but van Westen warns our infrastructure isn't built for that cold.
